proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab g k n hd hi hp
  have key : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → IntervalIntegrable f' MeasureTheory.volume a b → f a = f b → fourierCoeffOn hab f' n = (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n / ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ)) * fourierCoeffOn hab f n := by
    intro f f' hd hi hp
    have hba : ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (sub_pos.mpr hab).ne'
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      have h0 : ∫ x in a..b, (fourier (-(0:ℤ)) (x : AddCircle (b - a))) • f' x = 0 := by
        simp only [neg_zero, fourier_zero, one_smul]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd hi, ← hp, sub_self]
      haveI : Fact (0 < b - a) := ⟨sub_pos.mpr hab⟩
      rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral, h0]
      simp
    · have h := fourierCoeffOn_of_hasDerivAt hab hn hd hi
      rw [← hp, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_sub] at h
      have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
      rw [h]
      field_simp
      simp
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [key (g k) (g (k + 1)) (hd k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) (hi k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)) (hp k (Nat.lt_succ_self k)),
      ih (fun j hj => hd j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)) (fun j hj => hi j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)) (fun j hj => hp j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)), pow_succ]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (n : ℤ), (∀ j < k, ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt (g j) (g (j + 1) x) x) → (∀ j < k, IntervalIntegrable (g (j + 1)) MeasureTheory.volume a b) → (∀ j < k, g j a = g j b) → fourierCoeffOn hab (g k) n = (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n / ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ k * fourierCoeffOn hab (g 0) n
